messages:
incident-bot: Paging @oncall-maya — high 5xx spike detected in US-West (wsz1). Aggregated 5xx rate ~12% last 5m. Pager triggered. Link: https://internal.incidents/alert/3489

oncall-maya: on it, joining.

oncall-maya: quick triage: several generation pods in US-West showing memory pressure and connection errors. Impact appears to be POST /v1/generate and streaming. I estimate ~30m to stabilize if scaling/rollouts work. Will draft statuspage copy.

ben_ops: ack. Can you paste a short customer-facing line I can review and publish?

oncall-maya: draft below — open to edits

oncall-maya: ```
We are investigating increased 5xx errors affecting text generation in US-West. Some requests may fail or see truncated streams. Engineers are actively investigating and mitigating. We'll post updates every 15 minutes.
```

carla_support: +1 but please call out which endpoints so customers know if they're impacted. Also add that we don't expect data loss.

dave_eng: agree with Carla. Suggest removing internal jargon (don't say OOM) in public copy. Maybe 'resource pressure' instead.

elaine_prod: cadence proposal: initial, +15, +45, resolved. Legal — please review the wording before publish.

legal-bot: Reminder: avoid root-cause speculation in initial comms. Approve with edit: replace any definitive cause language with 'suspected resource pressure' until RCA.

oncall-maya: updated draft per feedback:

oncall-maya: ```
We are aware of increased 5xx errors impacting Generation endpoints (POST /v1/generate and streaming) in the US-West region. Some requests may fail or be truncated. We are investigating a suspected resource pressure issue. No customer data loss is suspected at this time. We will post updates every 15 minutes.
```

ryan_sre: +1. Can someone create the statuspage incident and drop the link here so we can pin it in customer replies? I'll prepare a cURL to hit the statuspage API for updates.

ben_ops: creating incident now and will post. Notifying CS and Sales separately after publish.

statuspage-bot: Incident (draft) created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026 (private)

oncall-maya: published initial update to statuspage. Copy: (same as draft).

carla_support: I'll start templated customer replies in the support queue referencing the statuspage link.

ben_ops: scheduling automated +15 update. Next manual check in 15 minutes.

dave_eng: mitigation in progress: scaling additional gen-replicas and rolling restart of the staging groups to relieve pressure. Patch queued to adjust kernel param.

oncall-maya: update +15: after scaling and restarts, 5xx rate reduced to ~4% in US-West. Some customers still impacted intermittently. Continuing monitoring and mitigation. Next update +30.

elaine_prod: pushing a short banner to Help Center: "We are investigating elevated errors for Generation endpoints in US-West; see status page for updates."

ben_ops: legal sign-off received for current copy. Preparing to publish +45 and resolved notices.

dave_eng: continuing root cause work — logs indicate a memory fragmentation pattern on a subset of kernels under heavy KV cache churn. Will follow up in postmortem.

oncall-maya: update +30: error rate trending down to baseline in most clusters. A few noisy nodes remain being drained. ETA for resolution: ~10–20m.

oncall-maya: resolved: marking incident resolved at 1749800450. 5xx rates returned to baseline after scaling and kernel parameter adjustments. No customer data loss detected. Postmortem ticket: PM-4567.

ben_ops: published resolved notice on statuspage and sent customer follow-ups.

carla_support: support queues cleared for affected cases; left canned follow-up with customers and CC'd account teams.

statuspage-bot: Incident INC-2026 marked resolved.

incident-bot: Incident closed by oncall-maya.
